copy.headline: Your capacity to keep moving and the internal load you carry while doing so need to be read together.
copy.body: Conscientiousness shapes planning, persistence, and completion; emotionality shapes how strongly uncertainty, mistakes, and pressure register internally. The same output can carry very different recovery costs.
copy.strength_sentence: Reading execution and load together separates reliable performance from sustainable performance.
copy.risk_sentence: Output alone can hide high-pressure maintenance, while stress reactions alone can hide structure that is already working.
copy.context_boundary: This interaction is clearest around deadlines, ambiguous responsibility, and sustained load; it may recede under a controllable pace.
copy.action_hook: Track both the completion signal and the recovery cost, not output alone.
